fact: From 3 October 2022 payment instrument issuers and payment system operators face fixed National Bank penalties per violation of its directives: Birr 100,000 or 25% of the excess over transaction or balance limits, Birr 20,000 per violation or customer otherwise, Birr 15,000 per late report.
title: Penalty for Non-Compliance with the Directives of the National Bank (Directive No. 955/2022)
publisher: National Bank of Ethiopia (የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ)
